source_row.society: Vascular Society of Great Britain & Ireland
source_row.extraction_instructions: LightMedia CMS, server-rendered. /events/ shows 'Only Upcoming' for the current year as div.date_row rows (dates | title link | location); later years are /events/calendar/date/<YYYY>/ and are walked for two more years (there is no ?page= pagination). The list mixes the Society's own events (ASM, ASPIRE courses) with promoted external congresses (LINC Leipzig, Paris Vascular Insights, Munich MAC, Zurich cardiology conference). Detail pages: h1.module_article_title, two p.module_article_metadata lines (dates, venue) and Event/Prices/Terms tab panes. Fees appear as a refundable-DEPOSIT table (ASPIRE), a [Ticket | Price] table, prose rate lines ('Early-bird rate: £310 (until midnight on 27 September)') or only on the organiser's site (one hop followed). The ASM page links to /annual-meeting/registration whose fee grid is an IMAGE.

registry_comment: Vascular Society events: LightMedia current-year + calendar/date/<YYYY> listing; deposit/ticket/prose/external-hop fee parsing; ASM fee image read via vision

concerns: UNPROVEN: the Annual Scientific Meeting fee grid (25-27 Nov 2026, three durations x early/standard, member/non-member/industry rates) is an image, https://www.vascularsociety.org.uk/_userfiles/pages/images/reg-rates.png on /annual-meeting/registration (coverage pattern #3). The extractor follows the registration link and sends the image to vision.extract_pricing_from_images, but on 2026-10-21 the vision chain returned empty / timed out, so the ASM row has pricing_tiers = []. The remediator's image explorer should pick it up once the vision models are healthy; the grid is public and verified by eye (Vascular Society Full £519/£470/£242 early bird).

Coverage checklist: #1 ranges parsed (including '14 Dec 12:05PM - 18 Dec 12:05PM 2026'); #2/#5 one hop to the organiser site when the event page has no fees (Paris Vascular Insights 24 EUR tiers and Munich MAC 24 EUR tiers read this way; hops use safe_fetch.fetch_validated with no browser fallback, so JavaScript registration apps such as LINC Leipzig, plus Find Your Algorithm and the Zurich conference, give no tiers); #3 ASM image (above); #4 /annual-meeting/registration followed; #6/#7 SRS2027 'Abstract submissions are open' has no deadline on the page - left to the pipeline merge step (coverage prints SUBMISSION_NO_DEADLINE).
ASPIRE courses are free to attend with a refundable £100 deposit; the deposit is stored as 'Refundable deposit · member/non-member' tiers, not as a £0 course fee.
Purely social items (Awards Ceremony, dinners) are skipped. Promoted external events are kept with their own venue and region 'international'. ASPIRE 8 (Jan 2027) has no venue on the page.
Specialty comes from the LLM / society default: the Zurich 'Cardiology & Cardiovascular Diseases' conference is returned as Cardiology by the LLM, other rows default to Vascular Surgery.

Text-LLM chain on 2026-10-21: nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b and meta/muse-glimmer-30b both answered 404 'gone', so the harness descriptions/specialties came from openai/gpt-oss-20b. Descriptions and specialty have deterministic backstops (first real paragraph; per-society default specialty), so extraction does not depend on the LLM. The probe_models job will go red until the chain is rotated.

specialty_classifier.classify_specialty is deliberately NOT used as the backstop: on single-specialty societies it returned wrong labels (Cardiology/Oncology/GP Training for hepatology webinars). The backstop is the society's own specialty constant when the LLM returns None.

Shared-helper wishes (not changed, per rules): pricing_tables.parse_pricing_tables keeps only the LAST price column when the header names are not timeframes (BSSH Scientific Meeting 'Full meeting | One day' lost the full-meeting rates), drops the category column of [Ticket | Category | Price] tables (BAUS), and can take a nearby sentence as the section name ('Registration fees do not include'). Each extractor carries a small local table helper instead (matrix_tiers / ticket_tiers / rowspan_tiers / external_fee_hop, duplicated inline per file).
coverage_checks SINGLE_DAY_SUSPECT / PRICE_TEXT_ON_PAGE warnings that remain in the harness are explained per source below; none is a missed fee or date on the event's own page.

2026-10-22 review fixes: (1) Munich MAC organiser prices use European number format ('1.500,00 €'); vascularsociety.py now parses dot-thousands/comma-decimals locally (Industry representative = 1500.0 EUR, bounded 0..10000) and keeps the table's section rows in the label ('Registration · Congress Ticket · Physicians', 'Registration · Day ticket on-site · Physicians · Thursday, 10th December 2026'). (2) The ASM row sets organiser_url to /annual-meeting/registration (the page holding reg-rates.png); the follow of that page now only happens when the event's own body links to /annual-meeting/ (the site-wide nav link had made every fee-less event follow it). Hardening 2026-10-21: external hops use safe_fetch.fetch_validated (no browser), host checks via urlparse().hostname; society-own pages keep fetch_html.
